title: The tunnels under the mall feel... unsafe

classification.question_topic: Asking if others have been to/experienced the tunnels under the mall and whether they feel unsafe/weird

meta.final_emotion: woke up (second time after reaching an offshoot again); memory felt muffled/underwater

position.relative_to: under the mall (author is not fully certain: 'I mean, I think they're under the mall')

qualities.raw_description: Feels like an older part of the mall; off-white/grey painted brick; exposed pipes; easily accessible breaker boxes and switches; 'feel... unsafe'; 'felt like I wasn't alone'; 'creeping through the tunnels'

locations.location_name: offshoot room or hall (in the tunnels)

qualities.raw_description: An offshoot room or hall; the dream ends after reaching it ('went into an offshoot room or hall and woke up'; 'managed to stay asleep long enough to get to an offshoot again before I woke up')

connections.qualities: Offshoot from the tunnels into a room or hall

interactions.description: First visit: felt like not alone and left quickly ('skadoo'd outta there pretty fast')

Second visit: blonde guy present; he told the dreamer something important about the mall/world; said 'this was all a dream'; dreamer felt themself waking up; he 'somehow kept me there'; he said he wasn't safe in the tunnels and the dreamer wouldn't be safe if they left then; they crept through the tunnels and talked about their lives; his voice/memory became 'underwater'/'muffled'; he was crying and seemed scared

entities_involved.description: blonde guy; seemed safe and familiar; crying at some point; seemed scared; voice later felt 'underwater'/'muffled'

interactions.description: Dream ends upon entering/reaching an offshoot room or hall (both visits end around reaching an offshoot)

extraction.extraction_notes: Two separate visits to the same tunnel location are described; exact layout, lighting, and broader mall context are not given. 'Under the mall' is stated with uncertainty. Temporal data is minimal but includes sequence (first vs second visit) and repeated waking upon reaching an offshoot; also mentions oversleeping alarms after the second visit.
